name: Open Items
rows: DRAFT · NOT FOR FILING · human review required; an officer signs and a person files

FA-2501 equipment trailer, 20-ton tilt deck, $24,600.00: purchase order PO-24-117 was signed December 18, 2024 and the trailer was placed in service January 27, 2025. Property acquired before January 20, 2025 gets the 40% allowance, so the draft deducts $12,792.00; the depreciation software took 100%, $24,600.00, $11,808.00 more. A person confirms the purchase order was a binding written contract on that date and corrects the register before filing Form 4562.

The members' written consent approving 2025 officer pay ($290,000.00: salaries of $150,000.00 and $110,000.00 and the President's $30,000.00 bonus) was prepared December 18, 2025 and neither member has signed it. The draft deducts the $260,000.00 of salaries paid in 2025 on line 12 and Form 1125-E; the bonus, accrued to a 60% owner and paid January 9, 2026, is deducted in 2026 under section 267(a)(2). A person obtains the signed consent and support that the pay is reasonable.

On June 30, 2025 HANGS wired $120,000.00 to Juniper Ridge Partners LLC, a single-member LLC owned by the Vice President (a 40% member), with no note, no interest and no repayment date. The draft carries it as a receivable on Schedule L line 6 and imputes no interest. A person decides whether it is bona fide debt (a signed note at a market rate with a repayment schedule) or a distribution to the Vice President, and whether section 7872 interest applies.

The third installment, due September 15, 2025, was $7,075.00 short; the December 15 payment made it up. The regular method gives a $123.47 penalty, entered on line 34. A person decides whether the annualized income installment method (Form 2220 Schedule A) lowers it, and whether to attach Form 2220 or let the IRS bill the penalty.

Unsigned draft. The 2025 return and the $11,125.80 balance were due April 15, 2026; Form 7004 extends only the time to file, to October 15, 2026. Resolve BONUS-01, OFFICER-01 and RELATED-01 first; an officer signs, and a person files. $4,623.11 of contributions carries over to 2026. Nothing has been filed.
